technical.summary: BRK-B shows solid bullish technicals with price above all major MAs and positive momentum crossovers, but weak ADX trend strength and overbought stochastic conditions limit swing entry conviction in neutral sector environment.

fundamental.summary: No actionable signals detected across insider, institutional, government, or retail channels; earnings in 59 days presents elevated risk with minimal conviction support.

risk.summary: Crisis-level VIX (399.36) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility; earnings in 59 days presents secondary binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive MACD/StochRSI crossovers and supertrend bullish signal provides technical entry setup, amplified by extreme market fear (29/100) creating contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis-level VIX (399.36), weak ADX trend strength (14.24), overbought stochastic conditions (80.77), zero fundamental conviction, and upcoming NFP event in 2 days create excessive near-term volatility risk that outweighs technical setup quality.
